methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected from each provider's own pricing page (corroborated with 2026 pricing review sources where the official page geolocated to non-USD currency or rendered prices via a JavaScript contact slider). All figures are monthly USD at each plan's stated base contact/subscriber tier; because most providers scale price by list size, the base-tier price is recorded and the included tier is noted. Quote-only Enterprise tiers are recorded with monthlyUsd null, and minutes/calls/overage fields are null (not applicable to email marketing).

vendors.name: Mailchimp
vendors.provenance: https://mailchimp.com/pricing/marketing/ (official; geolocated to EUR, USD base prices corroborated via emailtooltester.com and costbench.com 2026 reviews)

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 250 contacts and 500 monthly sends. 1 audience, 1 seat, basic templates, single welcome automation, basic reporting.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Base price for up to 500 contacts (scales with list, max 50,000). Monthly send limit 10x contacts. 3 audiences, 3 seats, automation flows, A/B testing, SMS add-on. Price climbs with contacts (~$75/mo at 5,000).

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Base price for up to 500 contacts (scales with list, max 100,000). Monthly send limit 12x contacts. 5 audiences, 5 seats, advanced segmentation, custom templates, multivariate testing. ~$100/mo at 5,000 contacts.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Base price includes up to 10,000 contacts (max 200,000). Monthly send limit 15x contacts. Unlimited audiences, unlimited seats, phone support, extended onboarding, advanced reporting.

vendors.name: Klaviyo
vendors.provenance: https://www.klaviyo.com/pricing (official; only Free tier shown, paid USD tiers via JS calculator, corroborated via omnisend.com and emailtooltester.com 2026 reviews)

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 250 active profiles, 500 monthly email sends, 150 SMS/MMS credits. Basic templates, drag-and-drop editor, segmentation, reporting. Email support first 60 days.

plans.name: Email
plans.notes: Starts at $20/mo for 251-500 active profiles with 5,000 monthly email sends (~10x contacts). Scales with active-profile tier (~$45/mo at 1,500, ~$720/mo at 50,000). No annual discount on self-serve.

plans.name: Email + SMS
plans.notes: Starts at $35/mo for 251-500 active profiles; bundles email sends plus SMS/MMS credits. Scales with active-profile tier and SMS volume.

vendors.name: ActiveCampaign
vendors.provenance: https://www.activecampaign.com/pricing (official; prices rendered via contact slider, USD figures at 1,000 contacts corroborated via tekpon.com and encharge.io 2026 reviews)

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: $15/mo at 1,000 contacts (annual billing). Limited segmentation, up to 5 actions per automation, standard integrations, 1 user. Price scales with contact band.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: $49/mo at 1,000 contacts (annual billing). Standard segmentation, unlimited automation actions, landing pages, 1 user. Scales with contact band.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $79/mo at 1,000 contacts (annual billing). Advanced segmentation, unlimited actions, premium ecommerce integrations, 3 users. Scales with contact band.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only. Premium segmentation, unlimited actions, dedicated account team, 5+ users, custom objects, SSO. Custom pricing required above 50,000 contacts.

plans.name: Newsletter (Free)
plans.notes: Up to 10,000 subscribers. 1 basic visual automation, unlimited landing pages and forms, unlimited email broadcasts, audience tagging/segmentation, sell digital products.

plans.name: Creator
plans.notes: Base price at 1,000 subscribers ($390/yr = ~$32.50/mo effective on annual). Unlimited visual automations and sequences, A/B subject testing, SMS, app integrations, remove Kit branding. Scales with subscriber count.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Base price at 1,000 subscribers ($790/yr = ~$65.83/mo effective on annual). Adds Subscriber Signals, engagement analytics, unlimited team users, advanced A/B testing (up to 5 variants), deliverability reporting, newsletter referral system.

vendors.name: Brevo
vendors.provenance: https://www.brevo.com/pricing/ (official; geolocated rendering, USD figures corroborated via costbench.com and emailtooltester.com 2026 reviews)

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Unlimited contacts, up to 300 emails/day. Email templates, drag-and-drop editor, signup forms, basic automation. Brevo brands by email volume, not contacts.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: From $9/mo for 5,000 emails/month (removes daily send limit). Price scales by email volume: $29/mo at 20,000 emails, $69/mo at 100,000 emails. No daily sending cap, basic reporting, no Brevo logo as add-on.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: From $18/mo for 5,000 emails/month. Scales by volume: $65/mo at 20,000 emails, $129/mo at 100,000 emails. Adds marketing automation workflows, A/B testing, advanced statistics, send-time optimization, phone support, landing pages.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only. Custom send volume, sub-account management, advanced security, dedicated account manager, SSO, tailored onboarding.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 500 subscribers, 12,000 monthly emails. Drag-and-drop editor, automation, 1 digital product, website, 10 landing pages, signup forms. 1 seat.

plans.name: Growing Business
plans.notes: Base price at 500 subscribers, unlimited monthly emails. Unlimited templates, dynamic emails, up to 3 digital products, auto-resend, multivariate testing, unlimited websites/landing pages. 3 seats. Scales with subscriber count.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: Base price at 500 subscribers, unlimited monthly emails. Adds smart sending, Facebook integration, unlimited digital products, custom HTML editor, promotion pop-ups, enhanced automations, preference center, AI writing assistant. Unlimited seats.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only, for 100K+ subscribers. Unlimited seats, 24/7 support, dedicated success manager, dedicated IP, onboarding, account audits.

vendors.name: GetResponse
vendors.provenance: https://www.getresponse.com/pricing (official; geolocated to EUR rendering, USD base prices corroborated via sender.net and temperstack.com 2026 reviews)

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: $19/mo at 1,000 contacts. Unlimited monthly email sends, autoresponders, welcome series, 1 automation workflow, landing page builder, signup forms/popups, 24/7 chat. ~18% off on annual. Scales with contacts.

plans.name: Marketer
plans.notes: $59/mo at 1,000 contacts. Adds unlimited automation workflows, advanced segmentation, abandoned cart recovery, sales funnels, unlimited web push, promo codes. Scales with contacts.

plans.name: Creator
plans.notes: $69/mo at 1,000 contacts. Knowledge monetization: course creator, paid courses, premium/paid newsletters, webinars (up to 100 attendees), up to 5 users, unlimited web push. Scales with contacts.

plans.name: GetResponse MAX (Enterprise)
plans.notes: Quote-only (book a demo). SMS marketing, dedicated support, SSO, unlimited users, transactional emails, custom proposal.

vendors.name: Constant Contact
vendors.provenance: https://www.constantcontact.com/pricing (official; USD base prices corroborated via thatmarketingbuddy.com and marketerschoice.com 2026 reviews)

plans.name: Lite
plans.notes: From $12/mo at base tier of up to 500 contacts. Email campaigns, AI content recommendations, templates, basic reporting, marketing calendar. Price scales with contact count.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: From $35/mo at base tier. Adds automation, segmentation, contact targeting, social posting, A/B subject testing. Scales with contact count.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: From $80/mo at base tier (range up to ~$425/mo as contacts grow). Adds advanced automations, dynamic content, custom segments, Google Ads manager, SEO recommendations, complete reporting.
